body:
[A0] Backlog: align sanitizer coverage with the generated build commands

The default empty CMake build type registers and runs ASAN/UBSAN-named tests while omitting their compile-time sanitizer flags. Their link commands still contain the sanitizer flags. Passing those named targets therefore needs a precise coverage statement.

Observed at PR #13 head `1789b70fe17333a09720f5061a871fd125ebb59f`, independently in both completed native review builds:

- `CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE:STRING=` is empty.
- `ptp_flags-test_ASAN` and `ptp_flags-test_UBSAN` have no `-fsanitize` in their generated `CXX_FLAGS`.
- The complete link commands contain `-fsanitize=address` and `-fsanitize=undefined`, respectively. Runtime linkage alone does not establish compiler instrumentation of the tested translation units.

The source explains the distinction: [generate_test_libs](https://github.com/kebag-logic/tsn-gen/blob/fde652067d3618f47fba2c2e8eb05f6c9f6fa97f/cmake/CMakeGenTestingLibraries.cmake) adds compile options only for Debug, Release, MinSizeRel and RelWithDebInfo. [target_link_testlibs](https://github.com/kebag-logic/tsn-gen/blob/fde652067d3618f47fba2c2e8eb05f6c9f6fa97f/cmake/CMakeLinkToTestlibs.cmake) adds link flags independently. These helpers are unchanged by the current flag and registration work.

Before implementation, record the supported configuration policy: make instrumented target compilation independent of an empty build type, or require and enforce an explicit supported build type in every advertised sanitizer command. The choice must preserve normal consumer build behavior and the existing registered tests. This issue remains Backlog until that scope is settled; executor and two independent reviewers are unassigned.

Acceptance for the eventual repair: inspect actual generated compile/link commands for the documented default and explicit configurations; exercise a small independent behavior control that fails for the intended sanitizer diagnostic and a normal passing control; retain direct child exits; run the applicable existing native and hosted gates; document the exact instrumented source population and any exclusions. No protocol value, expected frame or registration assertion should change as part of this work.

Existing native functional results retain their actual outcomes. Reports must distinguish named target execution, runtime linkage and compiler instrumentation. This issue supplies no new coverage, review approval or CI waiver.

Selected generated-command evidence follows. Checkout locations are tokenized; full original-file hashes identify the inspected files. The excerpts are explicitly selected build-type/flags lines or complete link.txt contents, rather than full generated files.

```text

```

```text
CXX_FLAGS = -std=gnu++17 -fPIE -DTRAFFIC_GEN_TESTS_RES_PATH=\"<CHECKOUT>/parser/tests/test_resources\"
```
